agency: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
title: ODNI-UAP-D001, USPER Narrative, Senior USIC Official
doc_notes: This is a narrative report from a senior U.S. intelligence officer detailing multiple close-range UAP encounters during a helicopter mission, and it contains direct encounter content.

encounters.summary: A UAP object rose from the ground, approached within ten feet of the helicopter, split into two, and sped away.
encounters.entity_behavior: rose from ground, approached helicopter, sped away
encounters.quote: approached within ten feet of the helicopter

encounters.summary: Two large oval-shaped orange orbs with white/yellow centers appeared stationary above the helicopter rotor disk, followed by others forming a T-formation.
encounters.entity_appearance: oval-shaped, orange with white or yellow center
encounters.quote: stationary and just above the rotor disk to our right
